title: Action Plan
description: A plan consisting of a sequence of robot actions with prerequisites and optional data flow between actions.

actions.description: Ordered list of actions to be executed by robots.

roll.description: Rotation around X axis in radians.

pitch.description: Rotation around Y axis in radians.

yaw.description: Rotation around Z axis in radians.

base_action.title: Base Action
base_action.description: Common fields shared by all action types.

action_id.description: Unique identifier for this action. Referenced by prerequisites and input_from_action_id.

executing_robot.description: Identifier of the robot that will execute this action (e.g. 'drone_1', 'forklift_1').

command.description: The command type to execute. Discriminates the action subtype.

command_arguments.description: Arguments specific to the command type.

prerequisites.description: List of action_ids that must complete before this action begins. Use an empty array for no prerequisites.

input_from_action_id.description: Optional. The action_id whose runtime output is injected as input into this action. Must also appear in prerequisites.

search_action.title: Search Action
search_action.description: Instructs a robot to search its environment and produce a result (e.g. a target location) for downstream actions.

command_arguments.description: No arguments required for a basic search.

move_action.title: Move Action
move_action.description: Instructs a robot to move to a target pose. The destination may be provided statically or dynamically via input_from_action_id.

destination.description: Target pose. May be an empty object when the destination is resolved at runtime via input_from_action_id.

oneOf.description: Empty object — destination supplied dynamically via input_from_action_id.

pick_up_action.title: Pick Up Action
pick_up_action.description: Instructs a robot to pick up a named object at its current location.

object.description: Identifier of the object to pick up.

drop_action.title: Drop Action
drop_action.description: Instructs a robot to drop a currently held object at its current location.

object.description: Identifier of the object to drop.

generic_action.title: Generic Action
generic_action.description: Discriminated union of all action subtypes, resolved by the 'command' field.
